Questions 21 and 22

Choose TWO letters, A-E.

Which TWO skills did Laura improve as a result of her work placement?

Questions 23 and 24

Which TWO immediate benefits did the company get from Laura’s work placement?

Questions 25–30

What source of information should Tim use at each of the following stages of the work placement?

Choose SIX answers from the box and write(drag) the correct letter, A-G, next to questions 25-30.

A company manager
B company's personnel department
C personal tutor

transcript.en: Hi, Laura could you spare a few minutes to talk about the work placement you did last summer?
transcript.zh: Laura，你好，你能不能抽几分钟时间跟我讲一讲你去年暑假做的实习？

transcript.en: I'm thinking of doing one myself ...
transcript.zh: 因为我自己也在考虑做个实习。

transcript.en: Hi, Tim.
transcript.zh: 你好，Tim，

transcript.en: Sure.
transcript.zh: 当然没问题。

transcript.en: Didn't you do yours at an environmental services company?
transcript.zh: 你去年是不是在一家环境服务公司实习的？

transcript.en: That's right ...
transcript.zh: 是的

transcript.en: It's only a very small company and they needed someone to produce a company brochure, and I wanted to get some business experience because I'm interested in a career in occupational psychology in a business environment.
transcript.zh: 那只是一家小公司，他们当时需要一个人制作公司宣传册，而我也想获得一些商务经验，因为我对与商务环境下的职业心理学相关的职业比较感兴趣。

transcript.en: It was good because I had overall responsibility for the project.
transcript.zh: 而且我可以对那个项目全权负责，所以还不错。

transcript.en: What kind of skills do you think you developed on the placement?
transcript.zh: 你觉得你通过这次实习获得了什么能力吗？

transcript.en: I mean, apart from the ones you already had ...
transcript.zh: 当然了，除去你本身就有的那些能力之外......

transcript.en: Did you have to do all the artwork for the brochure, the layout and everything?
transcript.zh: 你当时要自己做宣传册的插图、排版和所有事情吗？

transcript.en: We hired the services of a professional photographer for that.
transcript.zh: 我们雇了一位专业的摄影师来做那些，

transcript.en: I did have to use my IT skills to a certain extent because I cut and pasted text from marketing leaflets, but that didn't involve anything I hadn't done before.
transcript.zh: 我在某种程度上确实用到了IT能力来从营销传单上把文字内容裁剪下来，粘贴到宣传册上，不过这些事情我之前就做过。

transcript.en: Do you think you got any better at managing your time and prioritising things?
transcript.zh: 那你觉得这次实习结束之后，你在管理时间和分清事情的先后次序方面有没有变得更好呢？

transcript.en: You always used to say you had trouble with that ...
transcript.zh: 你以前说你在这方面总是遇到问题......

transcript.en: Oh, definitely.
transcript.zh: 哦，必须的。

transcript.en: There was so much pressure to meet the project deadline.
transcript.zh: 要赶在项目截止日期之前完工压力太大了。

transcript.en: And I also got better at explaining things and asserting my opinions, because I had to have weekly consultations with the marketing manager and give him a progress report.
transcript.zh: 而且我也更加擅长解释事情和发表看法了，因为我每个周都要和市场部经理进行一次讨论并且交给他一份进度报告。

transcript.en: It sounds as if you got a lot out of it then.
transcript.zh: 听起来你收获颇多啊。

transcript.en: Absolutely.
transcript.zh: 当然了，

transcript.en: It was really worthwhile ...
transcript.zh: 这次实习太值得了.....

transcript.en: But you know, the company benefited too ...
transcript.zh: 不过，我也给公司带来了好处啊......

transcript.en: Yes, they must have done.
transcript.zh: 对，肯定的。

transcript.en: After all, if they'd used a professional advertising agency to produce their brochure instead of doing it in house, presumably they'd have paid a lot more?
transcript.zh: 毕竟如果他们请了一家专业的广告公司来制作宣传册，而不是自己在公司里做的话，可能就要多花很多钱了。

transcript.en: Oh, yes.
transcript.zh: 是的。

transcript.en: I worked it out it would have been 250 per cent more.
transcript.zh: 我算过了，那样的话会多花百分之二百五的钱。

transcript.en: And I thought the end result was good, even though we did everything on site.
transcript.zh: 而且虽然我们所有的东西都是在现场做的，但是我觉得最终结果也还不错啊。

transcript.en: The company has quite a powerful computer and I managed to borrow some scanning software from the university.
transcript.zh: 公司里有配置超棒的电脑，而且我还想办法从学校里借了一些扫描软件。

transcript.en: The new brochure looks really professional; it enhances the image of the company straight away.
transcript.zh: 新的宣传册看起来非常专业，立马就提升了公司形象。

transcript.en: So in the long run it should help them to attract clients, and improve their sales figures?
transcript.zh: 所以，长期来看的话，这个会帮助他们吸引客户增加营业额，对吗？

transcript.en: That's the idea.Yeah.
transcript.zh: 就是这样，没错。

transcript.en: Well, all in all it sounds very positive I think I will go ahead and apply for a placement myself.
transcript.zh: 总的听起来效果还是很积极的，我想我也着手申请一个实习吧。

transcript.en: How do I go about it?
transcript.zh: 但是要怎么做呢？

transcript.en: It's easy enough to do, because there's a government agency called STEP S T E P that organises placements for students.
transcript.zh: 很简单的，因为有一个叫做STEP的政府机构会为学生组织实习。

transcript.en: You should start by getting their booklet with all the details I expect you can download one from their website.
transcript.zh: 你应该先从看一下他们的手册开始，那上面什么信息都有，我想你从他们的官网上就能下载一份。

transcript.en: Actually, they've got copies in the psychology department I've seen them there.
transcript.zh: 实际上，心理学系办公室就有那些手册，我在那儿看见过。

transcript.en: I'll just go to the office and pick one up.
transcript.zh: 我等会儿直接去办公室拿一份儿就行了。

transcript.en: Right.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: And then if I were you, after I'd looked at it I'd go over all the options with someone ...
transcript.zh: 可以啊。然后，如果我是你的话，在看完了手册之后，我会和某个人一起讨论一下所有的选择。

transcript.en: I suppose I should ask my tutor's advice.
transcript.zh: 我想我应该问问我导师的意见，

transcript.en: He knows more about me than anyone.
transcript.zh: 他比任何人都要了解我。

transcript.en: One of the career officers would be better, they've got more knowledge about the jobs market than your personal tutor would have.
transcript.zh: 就业指导老师可能更好一点，比起你的个人导师，他们对职场会更了解一些。

transcript.en: OK ...
And then when you know what you want you can register with STEP you'll find their address in the booklet.
transcript.zh: 等你了解了自己的选择之后，就可以在STEP上注册了，手册里有他们的网址。

transcript.en: And once you've registered they assign you to a mentor who looks after your application.
transcript.zh: 注册了之后，他们会把你分配给一位指导者，他会处理你的申请的。

transcript.en: And then I suppose you just sit back and wait till you hear something?
transcript.zh: 然后就光坐着等消息？

transcript.en: They told me at the careers office that it's best to be proactive, and get updates yourself by checking the website for new placement alerts.
transcript.zh: 就业指导办公室的老师告诉我最好要积极主动一点，你要自己查看网站上的新实习提示，多更新信息。

transcript.en: Your mentor is supposed to keep you informed, but you can't rely on that.
transcript.zh: 你的指导者本应通知你这些的，但是你不能完全依赖他。

transcript.en: I don't suppose it's a good idea to get in touch with companies directly, is it?
transcript.zh: 我猜直接和公司联系应该不是个好主意，对吧？

transcript.en: Not really ...
transcript.zh: 也不见得......

transcript.en: But it is the company who notifies you if they want you to go for an interview.
transcript.zh: 不过如果公司想要你去参加面试的话，他们会直接通知你的。

transcript.en: You get a letter of invitation or an email from personnel departments.
transcript.zh: 你会收到人事部门给你的邀请或者邮件。

transcript.en: And do I reply directly to them?
transcript.zh: 那我要直接回复他们吗？

transcript.en: Yes, you do.
transcript.zh: 嗯，要。

transcript.en: STEP only gets involved again once you've been made a job offer.
transcript.zh: 只有当你获得了工作机会之后，STEP才会介入。

transcript.en: Right ...
So, once you've had an interview you should let your mentor know what the outcome is?
transcript.zh: 那，一旦面试结束，是不是就要告诉指导者面试结果呢？

transcript.en: I mean whether you're offered a job, and whether you've decided to accept it?
transcript.zh: 像你有没有得到这个工作，还有你决定接不接受它之类的？

transcript.en: That's right.
transcript.zh: 没错。

transcript.en: They'll inform the careers office once a placement has been agreed, so you don't have to do that.
transcript.zh: 一旦实习申请通过了，他们就会通知就业指导办公室的，所以你不需要这么做。

transcript.en: Is that all then?
transcript.zh: 还有其他的事情吗？

transcript.en: More or less.
transcript.zh: 差不多就这些吧。

transcript.en: Only once you've accepted an offer you'll probably have to supply a reference, because the placement will be conditional on that.
transcript.zh: 差不多就这些吧。不过一旦接受了这个工作机会，你可能就要交一个介绍信，因为实习的工作会根据这个而定。

transcript.en: And that's something you should ask your own tutor to provide.
transcript.zh: 而这就是需要叫你的导师来做的事情了。

transcript.en: He knows about your academic ability and also about your qualities, like reliability.
transcript.zh: 他了解你的学术能力以及你的品性，比如可靠性。

transcript.en: Well, thanks very much for the information I'm starting to look forward ...
transcript.zh: 哦，太谢谢你跟我分享这些信息了，我已经开始期待......
